en.oCRDidNotFindReadableTextOnTheScannedPag: OCR did not find readable text on the scanned pages.
en.everyPageAlreadyHadATextLayerSoOCRWasNot: Every page already had a text layer, so OCR was not needed.
en.scannedPagesWereReadWithOcr: {count} scanned page(s) were read with OCR.
en.ocrExplainsTheTesseractRendering: Pages without a text layer are rendered and read with Tesseract.js. The first run downloads the English language data.
en.extractedBlocksCount: {count} block(s) extracted. Edit the output before copying if you like.

de.oCRDidNotFindReadableTextOnTheScannedPag: OCR hat auf den gescannten Seiten keinen lesbaren Text gefunden.

de.scannedPagesWereReadWithOcr: {count, plural, one {# gescannte Seite wurde} other {# gescannte Seiten wurden}} mit OCR gelesen.
